build.note: Read from the saved raw capture with the L3207 cell reader and the EBX decoder; no export, no new capture.

question: Which target material does each vehicle's damage-zone file store, and what grid values do the weapons have against the materials other than 119?

sourceFacts.method: Every saved file under Hardware/Vehicles whose name ends in _DamageZones was decoded and the material struct Field_c7584f55.Field_48288193 of each part object read; the upper 12 bits are the material ID (the Abrams control of L3201 reads 119 on six parts and 0 on two). The grid field Field_674633de was then read for 33 weapon files against each target material found, in both level grids.

control.description: Abrams DamageZones: six parts with material 119 and two with 0, as in L3201; RPG material 125 against 119 reads 2 as in L3205.

rawCheckSummary.tool: scripts/frosty-raw-check.py --manifest (stored values: raw-checks.json; grid reads: all-grid-rawchecks.json)

inference: IFVs, the AAV7A1, the Gepard, the JLTV and the Marauder use target material 119, the same grid column as the tanks; grid values read against 119 apply to them.
Helicopters use 121 and jets 120, which confirms from stored data the target split L3322 inferred from EA's numbers; the MQ-9 uses 233.
Light vehicles use 122, 187 or 123, with their own grid values. That the L3323 rule (damage x grid value) holds against them is an extension, not checked against any official figure.
unresolved: Whether the tank hit-quality steps apply to other vehicles on material 119. Test: one RPG on a Bradley's rear, 500 if they do.
No official or in-game figure for the light materials. Test: one RPG on a Vector, 708.5 by the rule.
Target 313 (CB90) returned no value. Test: one RPG hit on a full-health CB90.
Vehicles without a saved DamageZones file are not covered.
siteImpact: None. No Analyzer data, simulation or UI change.

leads.title: Target materials of all vehicles, and grid values against light vehicles
leads.summary: All 37 saved vehicle damage-zone files store a target material: 119 for tanks, IFVs, AAV7A1, Gepard, JLTV, Marauder and the CROWS turret; 121 helicopters; 120 jets; 122, 187 and 123 for light vehicles; 313 for the CB90. Grid values for 33 weapon files were read against each. 13192 raw reads matched.
leads.reopenWhen: An in-game reading against an IFV or a light vehicle, or a readable cell for target 313.
leads.statusNote: Stored materials read for every saved vehicle; rule against non-tank materials unverified; target 313 unread.
